This is a hypertension gut-microbiome study; many schema fields (tumor staging, disease response, neonatal, obgyn, HLA, zygosity) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

fmt_role field applies only to human donors (2 HTN, 1 control); recipients were germ-free mice, which are outside the scope of typical human participant schema fields.
